technology_name: A MAGNETORHEOLOGICAL FLUID DAMPER FOR VARIABLE VALVE ACTUATION TO IMPROVE ENGINE PERFORMANCE
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Smart Fluid Damper / Internal Combustion Optimization
problem_solved: Fixed mechanical engine valve camshaft profiles restrict thermodynamic combustion efficiencies across volatile RPM ranges, causing fuel waste and high emission output.
description: A specialized variable valve actuation dampening system utilizing a variable magnetorheological (MR) fluid damper chamber housing an internal magnetic coil setup that changes fluid viscosity instantly to modulate engine valve lift heights and timings.
applications: Variable valve actuation (VVA) performance loops, high-speed industrial automated press dampening, tunable valve shock absorption, and precision hydraulic limits.
